credit_line: Gift of Juan and Anna Marie Hamilton
description: Sheets of loose art paper and the reminder of a sketchbook.  This portfolio box contains approximately (50) sheets of unused art papers, of various textures, weaves and thicknesses, including Japanese paper, off-white drawing paper, papers in shades of cream and brown.  Also contains a spiral sketchbook for charcoal drawing, many sheets removed, along with old mounts belonging to Alfred Stieglitz, some with "AS" collection stamp.
title: Papers and Sketchbook ( in large black portfolio box)
